```
['extract text from raw PDF bytes using pypdf or PyPDF2, returning the combined page text or None', 'create a PDF text extraction utility that tries pypdf first then falls back to PyPDF2', 'test the PDF parser extracts text from bytes and returns None when no library is available', 'refactor the PDF parser to support additional extraction backends beyond pypdf and PyPDF2', "review the PDF parser's fallback logic between pypdf and PyPDF2 for robustness"]
```
